relationships.subject: Mexiletine
relationships.evidence_quote: The treatment of primitive erythermalgia is based on sodium channel blockers such as mexiletine or lidocaine infusions

key_findings: Erythermalgia work-up includes blood count and JAK2 mutation search; treated with sodium channel blockers, gabapentin or amitriptyline.
Raynaud's treatment relies on calcium channel blockers first line, iloprost in severe cases.
